# URL: UTS46 host processing, a/area URL parts, setter stripping

**IDNA.** `Internal/Idna/Uts46.cs` is domain-to-ASCII per UTS #46 (non-transitional, CheckHyphens off, CheckBidi and CheckJoiners on, no STD3 or length rules) over `idna-uts46.bin` (11 KB Brotli; generated by
`assets/unicode/generate_idna_table.py` from the checked-in Unicode 18 `IdnaMappingTable.txt` and `UnicodeData.txt`). Bidi classes and joining types come from `PeachDrawing.Text.Unicode`, virama code points from the table file. **The WPT data says a
label that starts with `xn--` is only decoded, not validated** (`xn--ab-j1t` with a ContextJ error still yields its own A-label): validating decoded labels cost 783 subtests, so it is not done.
**Trap.** `at += Read()` in C# evaluates `at` before `Read()` advances it; the table loaded misaligned and every ASCII label failed until the length was read into a local first.

**Anchors.** `a`/`area` get href, origin, protocol, username, password, host, hostname, port, pathname, search, hash from the bundle's URL parser (`hyperlink` object registered through `net.registerHyperlink`),
resolved against `baseURI`, which now honors the first `<base href>` of the document. URL setters (all but username and password) drop tabs and newlines first. `window.open` and a frame's `location`
assignment throw SyntaxError for a string that is not a URL.

**Harness.** The runner gave pages their address with a `<base>` put in front, which hid a page's own `<base>`; `RasterRenderContext.DocumentAddress` (new, public) now carries it.
Evidence: url 4735 -> 8516 of 8744 passing subtests. Left: `failure.html` iframe cases, a few host-setter corner cases, `percent-encoding`, `javascript:` URLs.
